dossiers.title: Prompt / Instruction Registry

requirements: Separate immutable policy/authority rules from editable prompting.
Bind each prompt/instruction version to intended model/capability and regression evidence.

implementation_levels.name: Intent & ownership
implementation_notes: Prompt / Instruction Registry owns only its declared masterplan behavior; adjacent-plane behavior remains behind declared contracts.
Owned capabilities: instruction registry, version resolution, instruction provenance.
acceptance: All production entrypoints resolve to one canonical VOL-241 owner.
Architecture validation rejects undeclared/shadow owners.

implementation_levels.name: Architecture & dependencies
implementation_notes: Canonical implementation surfaces: machine, skeleton/ai.
Model/provider objects terminate at adapter boundaries; decisions bind model, configuration, budget, privacy, usage and terminal reason.
acceptance: Dependencies are declared, governed and compatible with machine/architecture.json.
Illegal/missing dependency fails before expensive work.

implementation_levels.name: Contracts & compatibility
implementation_notes: Primary contracts: InstructionAsset, InstructionVersion, InstructionBinding.
Security-sensitive serialization uses stable identity/versioning, canonical parsing, explicit absent/null behavior and migration semantics.
acceptance: Round-trip plus malformed/duplicate/unknown-value tests exist.
Compatibility policy fails closed on unsafe ambiguity.

implementation_levels.name: Admission & authority
implementation_notes: Separate immutable policy/authority rules from editable prompting.
Attach principal/tenant, policy version, capability, budget, deadline and idempotency identity before protected work.
acceptance: Unauthorized/over-budget work causes no privileged side effect.
Fallback never weakens privacy, residency, authority or tenant isolation.

implementation_levels.name: Runtime control flow
implementation_notes: Bind each prompt/instruction version to intended model/capability and regression evidence.
normalize -> authorize -> reserve -> execute bounded capability -> persist/emit -> verify -> finalize receipt.
acceptance: Cancellation/deadline reaches every child operation.
No retry/recursion/delegation/search/background loop is unbounded.

implementation_levels.name: State & data semantics
implementation_notes: Classify Prompt / Instruction Registry data as authoritative, derived, cache or ephemeral with one owner.
Durable changes use transaction/outbox or explicit idempotency/compensation; declared derived state is rebuildable.
acceptance: Acknowledged authoritative writes are not silently lost.
Retention/deletion/migration/rebuild semantics are executable.

implementation_levels.name: Security, privacy & tenancy
implementation_notes: Zero-trust checks occur at the last responsible moment; identity, purpose, classification, residency and revocation follow protected work.
Threat/failure focus: prompt drift | instruction text mistaken for authority.
acceptance: Critical authz/tenant/secret/injection failures are non-compensable.
No undeclared protected material enters logs/prompts/artifacts/telemetry.

implementation_levels.name: Failure, resilience & recovery
implementation_notes: Open obligations: inventory instruction assets | bind to eval harness.
Define timeout outcome, retry budget, circuit/bulkhead/backpressure, crash boundary, replay behavior and recovery checkpoint for Prompt / Instruction Registry.
acceptance: Fault injection covers dependency, crash, replay, saturation, cancellation, stale identity and rollback.
Recovery creates no duplicate privileged effect or authority violation.

implementation_levels.name: Observability & operability
implementation_notes: Trace Prompt / Instruction Registry through decisions, dependencies, state, evidence and terminal result.
Emit structured success/failure, p50/p95/p99 where applicable, queue/resource pressure, retries, cost and recovery telemetry with redaction.
acceptance: Failed operations are reconstructable without process-local memory.
Telemetry overhead and redaction are tested.

implementation_levels.name: Performance, capacity & economics
implementation_notes: Declare a conventional baseline with identical workload/environment identity before optimization.
Reserve scarce resource/cost before expensive work; saturation uses bounded queueing/routing/shedding/rejection.
acceptance: Qualification includes tail and saturation behavior.
Optimization dequalifies when source/policy/profile identity is stale.

implementation_levels.name: Verification & adversarial evaluation
implementation_notes: Focused tests: planned:skeleton/testing/test_instruction_registry.py.
Evaluations: planned:instruction-version regression.

Verification must map each masterplan requirement, declared risk, trust boundary, concurrency invariant, and recovery obligation to deterministic tests or immutable evaluation evidence; every discovered failure becomes a versioned regression before promotion.
acceptance: Happy, negative, adversarial, concurrency and recovery behavior are exercised.
High-impact verification is independent or deterministically separated.

implementation_levels.name: Deployment, migration & rollback
implementation_notes: Deployment binds exact source/config/contracts/data migration/dependencies/artifact provenance.
Canary/readiness observes correctness, SLO, safety, cost and compatibility; rollback/reference fallback is rehearsed.
acceptance: No irreversible change lands without migration/reconciliation semantics.
Rollback restores compatible authoritative state within target.

implementation_levels.name: Operator controls & runbooks
implementation_notes: Prompt / Instruction Registry exposes health/readiness distinct from semantic correctness plus bounded diagnostic/support evidence.
Operator actions use preflight -> explicit admission -> execution -> immutable receipt; break-glass is scoped, expiring and audited.
acceptance: On-call can identify owner/state/dependency health/budget pressure/change/recovery action.
Administrative actions cannot silently bypass policy/evidence.

implementation_levels.name: Enterprise superiority & exit
implementation_notes: Inherits common enterprise contract and must reach at least enterprise_qualified.
Exit requires current exact-head evidence across correctness, security, tenancy, recovery, observability, performance/cost, compatibility and rollback.
acceptance: Target=enterprise_qualified; current=designed.
Legacy status (unverified) cannot promote enterprise grade without dossier-conformant evidence.

evidence_policy: Bind exact git head and governed source identity.
Bind workload/dataset, model/provider if applicable, environment/hardware, policy/contracts, scorer, cost/resource budget, raw-result digest and verifier verdict.
Expire evidence when governed source, contract, policy, evaluator or operating envelope changes.
dossiers.completion_rule: Never sign from prose, file existence, LOC, happy-path tests or legacy implementation status; sign only after exact-head dossier requirements and enterprise gates pass.
